sourceChange: The deployed source copied ERC20Adaptor and changed only its identifier string to ERC20 Adaptor Withdrawal Recovery Candidate V 1.0.
repositoryRepresentation: The repository contract inherits ERC20Adaptor and overrides only identifier(). Its metadata-free runtime is byte-for-byte identical to the deployed runtime. Solidity metadata differs because the repository uses a distinct source path and contract name.
identifierNote: The identifier string includes 'Candidate' and is fixed by the deployed bytecode. Do not rename it in source; a different string is a different identifier.
